channel.title: Rugspull Evidence Updates
channel.description: Dated, risk-first Rugspull evidence and operating-gate updates. Not live analytics, investment advice, an audit, or a safety signal.

item.title: How does a constant-product AMM calculate swaps?
item.description: A mechanism guide to stored RugToken/WBNB reserves, x times y, post-fee amount-out arithmetic, integer rounding, nondecreasing k, price impact, and direct-transfer surplus. A deterministic curve is not a liquidity, price, execution, audit, or safety guarantee.

item.title: What does slippage tolerance do on BNB Chain?
item.description: A risk-first guide to current-state estimates, constant-product price impact, minimum output, 20-minute deadlines, atomic reverts, and why wider tolerance cannot create liquidity or guarantee execution.

item.title: What does a token approval authorize on BNB Chain?
item.description: A spender-by-action guide for WBNB and RugToken allowances, actions that need no approval, exact-amount checks, and revocation limits. Correct approval hygiene does not guarantee contract safety, inclusion, price, liquidity, an exit, or recovery.

item.title: What is WBNB, and why does Rugspull use it?
item.description: A transaction-preparation guide separating native BNB gas from WBNB contract balances, wrapping, canonical-address checks, approvals, claims, and Rugspull's WBNB-only quote boundary. One quote asset does not guarantee price, inclusion, liquidity, safety, or recovery; total loss remains possible.

item.title: Office Counter report 003 — 2026-07-19
item.description: The Search Console sitemap row reports 36 discovered pages. URL Inspection classifies the new constant-product AMM guide as discovered but not indexed, detects the sitemap, records no referring page or last crawl, and accepted a priority request. Discovery and request receipts do not prove indexing, ranking, clicks, approval, audit, adoption, or endorsement.

item.title: How to claim a successful Opening entitlement
item.description: A wallet-specific guide to Active or Rugged claims, proportional RugToken and excess-WBNB formulas, integer rounding, one-shot execution, event verification, and the separate Failed path. Claiming is not a safety, value, liquidity, or transaction-success guarantee.

item.title: Who can finalize an Opening?
item.description: Any address may submit finalize after the cutoff, but the contract selects Failed or Active from the recorded total. Permissionless finalization is not automatic execution, prompt inclusion, an audit, or a safety guarantee.

item.title: Stage 0 Day 7 Gate Review — HOLD / NO-GO
item.description: The published gate review preserves unresolved audit, jurisdiction, custody, RPC, moderation, incident, email, and analytics conditions. Organized new mainnet activity remains NO-GO.

item.title: Community safety and anti-impersonation boundaries
item.description: Official channels, no-support-DM rules, correction handling, criticism policy, phishing boundaries, and the limits of the currently unstaffed response process.

item.title: BSC Testnet lifecycle evidence — TESTNET ONLY
item.description: Controlled Failed and Rugged BSC Testnet paths with reserve reconciliation. These are not mainnet users, volume, adoption, or an independent audit.
